integrity: Exact proof, explicit definitions, symbolic derivative identity and independent numerical convex-hull cross-checks included; all finite computations are supplementary, not proofs in unbounded dimension.
scientific_limitations: The uniqueness optimum is established only in dimension three and within the cube-plus-simplex one-parameter family at fixed Euclidean volume. Facet formulas extend to all n>=2 and t>0. The volume polynomial and simplex Gram determinants are not claimed as new. Historical priority remains provisional until broader independent review.
title: Sharp Euclidean surface optimization of a rank-one augmented cube
